reviews.text:
This is a corporate business, the vets are very restricted in their care for your pets.
Look for a business that puts your pets first

We took our Bichon Frise in for his booster jab, the reception staff were very friendly and welcoming, we were particularly happy with the vet Mikaella Petsa, she was just so kind and compassionate, it was a very good experience cannot thank her enough.
Excellent they had both my boys in for surgery last week. I'm very happy with Mikaela and the team. Thanks 💕 …

After moving from another vets, Our 2 cats just had their first 2 vaccine sessions. And our experiences have been fantastic.
Max was so gentle and caring with our babies and it was a joy to watch Michaela interact with the cats and was so positive and easy to speak with.
It feels wonderful to know I have a great vets.

Great vets! Really caring and and have always been great with my cat. Really helpful on the phone, and very efficient in appointments so you’re not waiting too long with anxious pets. Highly recommended.

This is a fabulous practice!  The nurses are amazing, very kind and caring, can't do enough for you, always have done their very best for our dogs.  They have taken the time to get to know our dogs, and are very patient with them so neither of them are nervous about visits to the vet.  We normally see Pete Rodgers but as he was not there on this occasion, we saw Max instead.  He was very kind and thorough, and was able to help quickly with Barney.  Many thanks!

always given very good advice, all staff are very friendly polite and helpful. Pete has always given me very good expert advice. my pets been registard with this vet since 2020, I highly recommened this vet practice. update: I have 5 adult cats and 1 kitten registard the veterinary clinic, last year 2 of my cats needed operations one was a urgent case he had lost part of his tail, he was given very good care until he was fully recovered, my other one had a gum disease she needed all her teeth taken out except her canine teeth, she was also  given very good care until she fully recovered. one of my cats is over weight he was put on a stricker diet yesterday by one of the vet's there, he has to weighed again in 4 weeks, this is the best vet all my pets have been under since living in Birmingham!

!!! Use the New Hall location !!! The difference is night and day.
They are so rude and dismissive in Erdington. Medication labels are all over the place. Insurance claims are shoved at the end of a drawer, you have to chase them and chase them.
They are not even friendly to the pets. Treating them like they are a mild inconvenience.
At New Hall they will actually call you and ask about the wellbeing of the pet, are lovely to talk to and the vet visit is never wasted.
I think this whole attitude starts from Reception.
If you read this, you know who you are.
Pete is amazing the best vet I've had and is so caring , all the staff here are lovely highly recommend ..

Be very careful, these chain vets are only bothered about one thing your money. We took our puppy for its first check up, mentioned its heart felt funny and told not to worry. Then 5 weeks later at the vet’s hospital and told heart problems caused lasting damage, limited life and daily medication while alive. The vet’s never wanted to know and completely washed their hands of any responsibility. Now at a private vet’s where they actually care about your pets.

Peter Rogers is exceptional, he’s very good with our nervous cats and puts us humans at ease too! The receptionists are also really helpful and knowledgeable. I would give this clinic more stars if I could ✨

Accessibility- the practice is wheelchair accessible. The carpark has paving stones with a slight incline to access the front door. There are limited car parking spaces on site, but I've never had a problem getting one.
The clinic rooms are a bit tight, but the furniture can be moved easily to accommodate your wheelchair.
The staff are kind, helpful and empathetic.
There are several bus stops by the vets and also on the cross roads that aren't that far away on foot.

I've been a customer of this vets for 9 years, with a dog who's always been healthy. He's been under the weather this week so I made an appointment and saw the vet, who only seemed to want to give him an injection and sell me  probiotic food. I kept telling her he hadn't been sick, nor had diahorria but smelt of fish and he wasn't walking, just sleeping. He had a stool and blood sample taken, but she kept repeating it was a mystery and did I want him to have the injection (which was already in the syringe). Came out none the wiser and was surprised to be given a bill for £457. No discussion of costs throughout the visit, I've been told before this vet is expensive, but I was shocked at the cost especially when I've come away with a dog that was poorlier than when he went in.

** EDIT : heartbreakingly, I lost my beautiful dog 3 days later, the blood test results showed he had chronic kidney failure so the only option was to let him go - I did have to ring twice though to speak to the vet to get the actual diagnosis. The clinic handled his passing very well, along with arranging his cremation and the return of ashes. For that, I'm grateful.
Lovely friendly vets. Very happy with the service
Amazing receptionist, gave me some good advice!!

top quality company my 2 dogs went to have a operation the ladies/nurses and the vet well looked after my 11 year old shizu dogs the waiting room was very clean every one of the staff was very courteous and helpful stage by stage through the day very good company

Pete Rogers is a fabulous vet, very caring and very knowledgeable.  The team he has working for him are all lovely and very good at their jobs.  He has looked after my dogs for several years, and because of the level of service provided by him, I have followed him on each of his moves.  I now have to travel over 20 miles each way but it's worth it as I totally trust him with my dogs.
Vets fees are expensive but if I can get the drugs on line cheaper, Pete is always happy to provide a prescription instead so I can save money.  Thank you Pete and the team.
Great vet experience, whole team was friendly and catered to my cats needs

The vet dismissed my concerns about our puppies heart which resulted in our puppy having heart failure on Christmas Day. Damage to her lungs and heart means they can’t operate and our puppies life expectancy is limited. All due to this incompetent and ignorant vet! Do not use if you want your pets to live!
Efficient service

Contacted RSPCA for a stray cat that has an infection they gave me a reference number saying to call this clinic on chester road, and that the reference will cover all cost. I explained to the girl on the phone that the cat has blocked nose, constantly sneezing, difficult breathing, black secretion from the eyes, and she said that they cant help, i have to pay but they are very busy and so on and so on... WHERE THE HELL AM I, YOU ARE SUPPOSED TO TAKE CARE FOR ANIMALS NOT FOR MONEY....
RSPCA reference: 01241305
I will complain everywhere i can.

My partners dog was choking as she had a bone lodged in her throat, we rushed her down to her registered vet as fast as we could as she couldn’t breathe, upon arrival we were told there weren’t any vets on site and we’d have to go elsewhere! How they could turn away an animal who couldn’t breathe is beyond me. Why have you not got any vets on site during opening hours? We were terrified we’d lose her. Absolutely awful. They did not care in the slightest nor did they offer any help. Luckily she is ok no thanks to them & we have now transferred her over to a different practice & they are brilliant.
Always a good experience there. The staff know my cats and I know they're loved and looked after. However, the prices are rather steep, especially when compared to other vets in the area.
That where great so good with my indoor cat and so very helpful.so glad I have joined them.
